verdict.rationale: Pipecat is an open-source (BSD-2) Python framework. A hands-on probe confirmed it pip-installs and is self-hostable, and the docs say the same bot file is portable to 'most production self-hosting setups', including distribution across processes and machines. The built-in development runner is explicitly not for production use, and the pack has no detailed production self-hosting guide. Missing for 10: a documented production self-hosting deployment guide (e.g. containers/orchestration) and independent corroboration of production self-hosted runs.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can self-host the voice agent runtime from open-source code on my own infrastructure
